title: Creatine Supplementation During GLP-1a Therapy
official: A Pilot Study on Creatine Supplementation During Resistance-training for Prevention of Lean Tissue Mass Loss During GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Therapy
summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists are effective for weight loss, but significant muscle mass is lost as a proportion of this weight loss. This study combines resistance-training and creatine supplementation to try to prevent this loss of muscle mass.

interventions.name: Dietary supplementation during a 12 week resistance-training program (creatine)
Dietary supplementation during a 12 week resistance-training program (placebo)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Starting GLP-1 agonist therapy
* 18 years of age or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* Positive answers to a screening questionnaire for physical activity safety (the Get Active Questionnaire)
